name: Finset.hasSum_sum
statement:
lemma Finset.hasSum_sum [AddCommMonoid β] [TopologicalSpace β] {s : Finset α} {f : α → β}
    (h : ∀ x, x ∉ s → f x = 0) : HasSum f (s.sum f)

name: Finset.sum_eq_sum_zero_off_inter
statement:
lemma Finset.sum_eq_sum_zero_off_inter {s0 s1 : Finset α} {g : α → ℝ}
    (h : ∀ x, x ∉ s0 ∨ x ∉ s1 → g x = 0) : s0.sum g = s1.sum g

name: Finset.sum_le_sum_of_map
statement:
lemma Finset.sum_le_sum_of_map {s : Finset α} {t : Finset β} {u : α → ℝ} {v : β → ℝ} (i : α → β)
    (inj : ∀ x0 x1, u x0 ≠ 0 → u x1 ≠ 0 → i x0 = i x1 → x0 = x1)
    (le : ∀ x, u x ≠ 0 → u x ≤ v (i x))
    (tv : ∀ y, y ∉ t → v y = 0)
    (v0 : ∀ y, y ∈ t → 0 ≤ v y) :
    s.sum u ≤ t.sum v

name: Finset.sum_ne_top
statement: lemma Finset.sum_ne_top {s : Finset α} {f : α → ENNReal} (ft : ∀ x, f x ≠ ⊤) : s.sum f ≠ ⊤

name: Finset.sum_ofReal
statement:
lemma Finset.sum_ofReal {s : Finset α} {f : α → ℝ} (f0 : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x) :
    s.sum (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (f x)) = .ofReal (s.sum f)

name: Finset.sum_toReal
statement:
lemma Finset.sum_toReal {s : Finset α} {f : α → ENNReal} (ft : ∀ x, f x ≠ ⊤) :
    s.sum (fun x => ENNReal.toReal (f x)) = ENNReal.toReal (s.sum f)

name: Prob.ext
statement: @[ext] lemma ext {f g : Prob α} (h : ∀ x, f.prob x = g.prob x) : f = g

name: Prob.mem_iff
statement: lemma mem_iff {f : Prob α} {x : α} : x ∈ f.supp ↔ f.prob x ≠ 0

name: Prob.mem_iff_pos
statement: lemma mem_iff_pos {f : Prob α} {x : α} : x ∈ f.supp ↔ 0 < f.prob x

name: Prob.zero
statement: lemma zero (f : Prob α) {x : α} (m : x ∉ f.supp) : f.prob x = 0

name: Prob.zero_iff
statement: lemma zero_iff {f : Prob α} {x : α} : f.prob x = 0 ↔ x ∉ f.supp

name: ite_and_one_zero
ite_le_ite_iff
statement:
lemma ite_le_ite_iff (x y : Prop) {dx : Decidable x} {dy : Decidable y} :
    (@ite _ x dx (1:ℝ) 0) ≤ (@ite _ y dy 1 0) ↔ x → y

name: ite_one_zero_congr
statement:
lemma ite_one_zero_congr (x y : Prop) {dx : Decidable x} {dy : Decidable y} :
    @ite _ x dx (1:ℝ) 0 = @ite _ y dy (1:ℝ) 0 ↔ (x ↔ y)

name: ite_one_zero_ne_zero
statement: lemma ite_one_zero_ne_zero (x : Prop) {dx : Decidable x} : @ite _ x dx (1:ℝ) 0 ≠ 0 ↔ x

name: ite_one_zero_nonneg
statement: lemma ite_one_zero_nonneg {x : Prop} {d : Decidable x} : 0 ≤ @ite _ x d (1:ℝ) 0

name: Prob.assoc
statement:
lemma assoc (f : Prob α) (g : α → Prob β) (h : β → Prob γ) :
    f >>= g >>= h = f >>= (λ x ↦ g x >>= h)

name: Prob.bind_comm
statement:
lemma bind_comm (f : Prob α) (g : Prob β) (h : α → β → Prob γ) :
    f >>= (λ x ↦ g >>= (λ y ↦ h x y)) = g >>= (λ y ↦ f >>= (λ x ↦ h x y))

name: Prob.bind_comm_of_eq
statement:
lemma bind_comm_of_eq (f : Prob α) (g : Prob β) (h0 h1 : α → β → Prob γ) (e : h0 = h1) :
    f >>= (λ x ↦ g >>= (λ y ↦ h0 x y)) = g >>= (λ y ↦ f >>= (λ x ↦ h1 x y))

name: Prob.bind_congr
statement:
lemma bind_congr (f : Prob α) (g h : α → Prob β) (e : ∀ x, f.prob x ≠ 0 → g x = h x) :
    f >>= g = f >>= h

name: Prob.bind_const
statement: @[simp] lemma bind_const (f : Prob α) (g : Prob β) : f >>= (λ _ ↦ g) = g

name: Prob.bool_prob_false_of_true
statement: lemma bool_prob_false_of_true {f : Prob Bool} : f.prob false = 1 - f.prob true

name: Prob.bool_prob_true_of_false
statement: lemma bool_prob_true_of_false {f : Prob Bool} : f.prob true = 1 - f.prob false

name: Prob.bool_total
statement: lemma bool_total (f : Prob Bool) : f.prob true + f.prob false = 1

name: Prob.exp_bind
statement:
lemma exp_bind (f : Prob α) (g : α → Prob β) (h : β → ℝ) :
    (f >>= g).exp h = f.exp (λ x ↦ (g x).exp h)

name: Prob.exp_comm
statement:
lemma exp_comm (f : Prob α) (g : Prob β) (h : α → β → ℝ) :
    f.exp (λ x ↦ g.exp (λ y ↦ h x y)) = g.exp (λ y ↦ f.exp (λ x ↦ h x y))

name: Prob.exp_congr
statement:
lemma exp_congr {f : Prob α} {g h : α → ℝ} (e : ∀ x, f.prob x ≠ 0 → (g x = h x)) :
    f.exp g = f.exp h

name: Prob.exp_congr'
statement:
lemma exp_congr' {f g : Prob α} {u v : α → ℝ} (h : ∀ x, f.prob x * u x = g.prob x * v x) :
    f.exp u = g.exp v

name: Prob.exp_const
statement: @[simp] lemma exp_const (f : Prob α) (x : ℝ) : f.exp (λ _ ↦ x) = x

name: Prob.exp_pure
statement: @[simp] lemma exp_pure (x : α) (f : α → ℝ) : (pure x : Prob α).exp f = f x

name: Prob.fintype_total
statement: lemma fintype_total (f : Prob α) [Fintype α] : (Finset.univ : Finset α).sum f.prob = 1

name: Prob.le_prob_bind_of_cut
statement:
lemma le_prob_bind_of_cut {f : Prob α} {g : α → Prob β} (x : α) {y : β} :
    f.prob x * (g x).prob y ≤ (f >>= g).prob y

name: Prob.left_id
statement: lemma left_id (f : Prob α) : f >>= pure = f

name: Prob.map_const
statement: lemma map_const (y : β) (x : Prob α) : (λ _ ↦ y) <$> x = pure y

name: Prob.map_eq
statement: lemma map_eq (f : α → β) (x : Prob α) : f <$> x = x >>= (λ x ↦ pure (f x))

name: Prob.map_prob_of_inj
statement:
lemma map_prob_of_inj {f : α → β} (inj : f.Injective) (x : Prob α) (y : α) :
    (f <$> x).prob (f y) = x.prob y

name: Prob.not_bool_prob
statement: lemma not_bool_prob {f : Prob Bool} {x : Bool} : (not <$> f).prob x = f.prob (not x)

name: Prob.pr_congr
statement:
lemma pr_congr {f : Prob α} {p q : α → Prop} (e : ∀ x, f.prob x ≠ 0 → (p x ↔ q x)) :
    f.pr p = f.pr q

name: Prob.prob_bind
statement:
lemma prob_bind (f : Prob α) (g : α → Prob β) (y : β) :
    (f >>= g).prob y = f.exp (λ x ↦ (g x).prob y)

name: Prob.prob_bind'
statement:
lemma prob_bind' (f : Prob α) (g : α → Prob β) :
    (f >>= g).prob = f.prob.sum (λ x p ↦ p • (g x).prob)

name: Prob.prob_le_one
statement: lemma prob_le_one (f : Prob α) (x : α) : f.prob x ≤ 1

name: Prob.prob_map
statement: lemma prob_map (f : α → β) (x : Prob α) (z : β) : (f <$> x).prob z = x.pr (λ y ↦ f y = z)

name: Prob.prob_mem_Icc
statement: lemma prob_mem_Icc (f : Prob α) (x : α) : f.prob x ∈ Icc 0 1

name: Prob.prob_pure
statement: lemma prob_pure (x y : α) : (pure x : Prob α).prob y = if y = x then 1 else 0

name: Prob.prob_pure'
statement: lemma prob_pure' (x : α) : (pure x : Prob α).prob = Finsupp.single x 1

name: Prob.right_id
statement: lemma right_id (x : α) (f : α → Prob β) : pure x >>= f = f x

name: Prob.seqLeft_eq
statement: lemma seqLeft_eq (x : Prob α) (y : Prob β) : x <* y = x >>= (λ x ↦ y >>= λ _ ↦ pure x)

name: Prob.seqRight_eq
statement: lemma seqRight_eq (x : Prob α) (y : Prob β) : x *> y = x >>= (λ _ ↦ y)

name: Prob.seq_eq
statement: lemma seq_eq (f : Prob (α → β)) (x : Prob α) : f <*> x = f >>= (λ f ↦ f <$> x)

name: Prob.add_eq
statement: lemma add_eq (f g : Prob ℝ) : f + g = do let x ← f; let y ← g; return x + y

name: Prob.cexp_enrich
statement:
lemma cexp_enrich {f : Prob α} {g : α → Prob β} {u : β → ℝ} {q : β → Prop} :
    (f >>= g).cexp u q = (f >>= (λ x ↦ Prod.mk x <$> g x)).cexp (λ y ↦ u y.2) (λ y ↦ q y.2)

name: Prob.exp_add
statement: lemma exp_add (f : Prob α) (g h : α → ℝ) : f.exp (λ x ↦ g x + h x) = f.exp g + f.exp h

name: Prob.exp_add_const
statement: lemma exp_add_const (f : Prob α) (g : α → ℝ) (h : ℝ) : f.exp (λ x ↦ g x + h) = f.exp g + h

name: Prob.exp_bool
statement:
lemma exp_bool (f : Prob Bool) (g : Bool → ℝ) :
    f.exp g = f.prob false * g false + f.prob true * g true

name: Prob.exp_const_add
statement: lemma exp_const_add (f : Prob α) (g : ℝ) (h : α → ℝ) : f.exp (λ x ↦ g + h x) = g + f.exp h

name: Prob.exp_const_mul
statement:
lemma exp_const_mul (s : ℝ) (f : Prob α) (g : α → ℝ) :
    f.exp (λ x ↦ s * g x) = s * f.exp (λ x ↦ g x)

name: Prob.exp_div
statement: lemma exp_div (s : ℝ) (f : Prob α) (g : α → ℝ) : f.exp (λ x ↦ g x / s) = f.exp (λ x ↦ g x) / s

name: Prob.exp_enrich
statement:
lemma exp_enrich {f : Prob α} {g : α → Prob β} {u : β → ℝ} :
    (f >>= g).exp u = (f >>= (λ x ↦ Prod.mk x <$> g x)).exp (λ y ↦ u y.2)

name: Prob.exp_eq_prob
statement:
lemma exp_eq_prob (f : Prob α) (y : α) {d : ∀ x, Decidable (x = y)} :
    f.exp (λ x ↦ @ite _ (x = y) (d _) (1:ℝ) 0) = f.prob y

name: Prob.exp_eq_zero
statement: lemma exp_eq_zero {f : Prob α} {u : α → ℝ} (u0 : ∀ x, f.prob x ≠ 0 → u x = 0) : f.exp u = 0

name: Prob.exp_eq_zero_iff
statement:
lemma exp_eq_zero_iff {f : Prob α} {u : α → ℝ} (h : ∀ x, f.prob x ≠ 0 → 0 ≤ u x) :
    f.exp u = 0 ↔ ∀ x, f.prob x ≠ 0 → u x = 0

name: Prob.exp_fintype
statement:
lemma exp_fintype (f : Prob α) [Fintype α] (g : α → ℝ) :
    f.exp g = Finset.univ.sum (fun x ↦ f.prob x * g x)

name: Prob.exp_le_exp_of_map
statement:
lemma exp_le_exp_of_map {f : Prob α} {g : Prob β} {u : α → ℝ} {v : β → ℝ} (i : α → β)
    (inj : ∀ x0 x1, f.prob x0 * u x0 ≠ 0 → f.prob x1 * u x1 ≠ 0 → i x0 = i x1 → x0 = x1)
    (uv : ∀ x, f.prob x * u x ≠ 0 → f.prob x * u x ≤ g.prob (i x) * v (i x))
    (v0 : ∀ y, g.prob y ≠ 0 → 0 ≤ v y) : f.exp u ≤ g.exp v

name: Prob.exp_le_of_forall_le
statement:
lemma exp_le_of_forall_le {f : Prob α} {u : α → ℝ} {b : ℝ} (h : ∀ x, f.prob x ≠ 0 → u x ≤ b) :
    f.exp u ≤ b

name: Prob.exp_lt_exp
statement:
lemma exp_lt_exp {f : Prob α} {g h : α → ℝ} (le : ∀ x, f.prob x ≠ 0 → g x ≤ h x)
    (lt : ∃ x, f.prob x ≠ 0 ∧ g x < h x) : f.exp g < f.exp h

name: Prob.exp_map
statement: lemma exp_map (f : α → β) (g : Prob α) (h : β → ℝ) : (f <$> g).exp h = g.exp (h ∘ f)

name: Prob.exp_mono
statement:
lemma exp_mono {f : Prob α} {g h : α → ℝ} (gh : ∀ x, f.prob x ≠ 0 → g x ≤ h x) :
    f.exp g ≤ f.exp h

name: Prob.exp_mono'
statement:
lemma exp_mono' {f g : Prob α} (u v : α → ℝ) (h : ∀ x, f.prob x * u x ≤ g.prob x * v x) :
    f.exp u ≤ g.exp v

name: Prob.exp_mul_const
statement:
lemma exp_mul_const (s : ℝ) (f : Prob α) (g : α → ℝ) :
    f.exp (λ x ↦ g x * s) = f.exp (λ x ↦ g x) * s

name: Prob.exp_nonneg
statement: lemma exp_nonneg {f : Prob α} {g : α → ℝ} (g0 : ∀ x, f.prob x ≠ 0 → 0 ≤ g x) : 0 ≤ f.exp g

name: Prob.le_exp_of_cut
statement:
lemma le_exp_of_cut {f : Prob α} {u : α → ℝ} (i : α → Prop) (a b : ℝ) (fi : a ≤ f.pr i)
    (iu : ∀ x, f.prob x ≠ 0 → i x → b ≤ u x) (u0 : ∀ x, f.prob x ≠ 0 → ¬i x → 0 ≤ u x)
    (b0 : 0 ≤ b) : a * b ≤ f.exp u

name: Prob.le_exp_of_forall_le
statement:
lemma le_exp_of_forall_le {f : Prob α} {u : α → ℝ} {b : ℝ} (h : ∀ x, f.prob x ≠ 0 → b ≤ u x) :
    b ≤ f.exp u

name: Prob.le_pr_bind_of_cut
statement:
lemma le_pr_bind_of_cut {f : Prob α} {g : α → Prob β} {p : β → Prop} {i : α → Prop} (a b : ℝ)
    (fi : a ≤ f.pr i) (gp : ∀ x, f.prob x ≠ 0 → i x → b ≤ (g x).pr p) (b0 : 0 ≤ b) :
    a * b ≤ (f >>= g).pr p

name: Prob.markov
statement:
lemma markov (f : Prob ℝ) (f0 : ∀ x, f.prob x ≠ 0 → 0 ≤ x) {a : ℝ} (a0 : 0 < a) :
    f.pr (λ x ↦ a ≤ x) ≤ f.mean / a

name: Prob.markov'
statement:
lemma markov' (f : Prob α) (g : α → ℝ) (f0 : ∀ x, f.prob x ≠ 0 → 0 ≤ g x) {a : ℝ} (a0 : 0 < a) :
    f.pr (λ x ↦ a ≤ g x) ≤ f.exp g / a

name: Prob.mean_add
statement: lemma mean_add (f g : Prob ℝ) : (f + g).mean = f.mean + g.mean

name: Prob.mean_bind
statement: lemma mean_bind (f : Prob α) (g : α → Prob ℝ) : (f >>= g).mean = f.exp (λ x ↦ (g x).mean)

name: Prob.mean_map
statement: lemma mean_map (f : α → ℝ) (g : Prob α) : (f <$> g).mean = g.exp f

name: Prob.mean_mul
statement: lemma mean_mul (f g : Prob ℝ) : (f * g).mean = f.mean * g.mean

name: Prob.mean_pure
statement: lemma mean_pure (x : ℝ) : (pure x : Prob ℝ).mean = x

name: Prob.mean_smul
statement: lemma mean_smul (s : ℝ) (f : Prob ℝ) : (s • f).mean = s * f.mean

name: Prob.mul_eq
statement: lemma mul_eq (f g : Prob ℝ) : f * g = do let x ← f; let y ← g; return x * y

name: Prob.neg_eq
statement: lemma neg_eq (f : Prob ℝ) : -f = do let x ← f; return -x

name: Prob.one_eq
statement: lemma one_eq : (1 : Prob ℝ) = pure 1

name: Prob.pr_and_const
statement:
lemma pr_and_const {f : Prob α} {p : α → Prop} {q : Prop} :
    f.pr (λ x ↦ p x ∧ q) = f.pr p * (if q then 1 else 0)

name: Prob.pr_bind
statement:
lemma pr_bind {f : Prob α} {g : α → Prob β} (p : β → Prop) :
    (f >>= g).pr p = f.exp (λ x ↦ (g x).pr p)

name: Prob.pr_const
statement: lemma pr_const (f : Prob α) (p : Prop) : f.pr (λ _ ↦ p) = if p then (1:ℝ) else 0

name: Prob.pr_enrich
statement:
lemma pr_enrich {f : Prob α} {g : α → Prob β} {p : β → Prop} :
    (f >>= g).pr p = (f >>= (λ x ↦ Prod.mk x <$> g x)).pr (λ y ↦ p y.2)

name: Prob.pr_eq_add_of_cut
statement:
lemma pr_eq_add_of_cut {f : Prob α} {p : α → Prop} (q : α → Prop) :
    f.pr p = f.pr (fun x ↦ p x ∧ q x) + f.pr (fun x ↦ p x ∧ ¬q x)

name: Prob.pr_eq_one
statement: lemma pr_eq_one {f : Prob α} {p : α → Prop} : f.pr p = 1 ↔ ∀ x, f.prob x ≠ 0 → p x

name: Prob.pr_eq_prob
statement: lemma pr_eq_prob (f : Prob α) (y : α) : f.pr (λ x ↦ x = y) = f.prob y

name: Prob.pr_eq_zero
statement: lemma pr_eq_zero {f : Prob α} {p : α → Prop} : f.pr p = 0 ↔ ∀ x, f.prob x ≠ 0 → ¬p x

name: Prob.pr_false
statement: lemma pr_false {f : Prob α} : f.pr (λ _ ↦ False) = 0

name: Prob.pr_le_one
statement: lemma pr_le_one {f : Prob α} {p : α → Prop} : f.pr p ≤ 1

name: Prob.pr_lt_pr
statement:
lemma pr_lt_pr {f : Prob α} {p q : α → Prop} (le : ∀ x, f.prob x ≠ 0 → p x → q x)
    (lt : ∃ x, f.prob x ≠ 0 ∧ ¬p x ∧ q x) : f.pr p < f.pr q

name: Prob.pr_map
statement: lemma pr_map {f : α → β} {g : Prob α} (p : β → Prop) : (f <$> g).pr p = g.pr (λ x ↦ p (f x))

name: Prob.pr_mem_Icc
statement: lemma pr_mem_Icc {f : Prob α} {p : α → Prop} : f.pr p ∈ Icc 0 1

name: Prob.pr_mono
statement:
lemma pr_mono {f : Prob α} {p q : α → Prop} (pq : ∀ x, f.prob x ≠ 0 → p x → q x) :
    f.pr p ≤ f.pr q

name: Prob.pr_ne_zero
statement: lemma pr_ne_zero (f : Prob α) (p : α → Prop) : f.pr p ≠ 0 ↔ ∃ x, f.prob x ≠ 0 ∧ p x

name: Prob.pr_neg
statement: lemma pr_neg {f : Prob α} {p : α → Prop} : f.pr (λ x ↦ ¬p x) = 1 - f.pr p

name: Prob.pr_neg'
statement: lemma pr_neg' {f : Prob α} {p : α → Prop} : f.pr p = 1 - f.pr (λ x ↦ ¬p x)

name: Prob.pr_nonneg
statement: lemma pr_nonneg {f : Prob α} {p : α → Prop} : 0 ≤ f.pr p

name: Prob.pr_or_le
statement: lemma pr_or_le {f : Prob α} (p q : α → Prop) : f.pr (λ x ↦ p x ∨ q x) ≤ f.pr p + f.pr q

name: Prob.pr_pure
statement: lemma pr_pure {x : α} (p : α → Prop) : (pure x : Prob α).pr p = if p x then 1 else 0

name: Prob.pr_true
statement: lemma pr_true {f : Prob α} : f.pr (λ _ ↦ True) = 1

name: Prob.prob_bind_ne_zero
statement:
lemma prob_bind_ne_zero (f : Prob α) (g : α → Prob β) (y : β) :
    (f >>= g).prob y ≠ 0 ↔ ∃ x, f.prob x ≠ 0 ∧ (g x).prob y ≠ 0

name: Prob.smul_eq
statement: lemma smul_eq (s : ℝ) (f : Prob ℝ) : s • f = do let x ← f; return s * x

name: Prob.zero_eq
statement: lemma zero_eq : (0 : Prob ℝ) = pure 0

name: Prob.average_le_max
statement: lemma average_le_max {p x y : ℝ} (m : p ∈ Icc 0 1) : x*p + y*(1-p) ≤ max x y

name: Prob.bayes
statement:
theorem bayes (f : Prob α) (a b : α → Prop) (b0 : f.pr b ≠ 0) :
    f.cond a b = f.cond b a * f.pr a / f.pr b

name: Prob.bayes'
statement: lemma bayes' (f : Prob α) (a b : α → Prop) : f.cond a b * f.pr b = f.cond b a * f.pr a

name: Prob.cexp_add
statement: lemma cexp_add {u v : α → ℝ} : f.cexp (λ x ↦ u x + v x) q = f.cexp u q + f.cexp v q

name: Prob.cexp_bind_le_of_cut
statement:
lemma cexp_bind_le_of_cut {f : Prob α} {g : α → Prob β} {u : β → ℝ} {q : β → Prop} (i : α → Prop) :
    (f >>= g).cexp u q ≤
      max ((f >>= λ x ↦ Prod.mk x <$> g x).cexp (λ y ↦ u y.2) (λ y ↦ q y.2 ∧ i y.1))
           ((f >>= λ x ↦ Prod.mk x <$> g x).cexp (λ y ↦ u y.2) (λ y ↦ q y.2 ∧ ¬i y.1))

name: Prob.cexp_congr
statement:
lemma cexp_congr {u v : α → ℝ} (uv : ∀ x, f.prob x ≠ 0 → q x → u x = v x) :
    f.cexp u q = f.cexp v q

name: Prob.cexp_const_mul
statement: lemma cexp_const_mul {s : ℝ} : f.cexp (λ x ↦ s * u x) q = s * f.cexp u q

name: Prob.cexp_eq_cexp_add_cexp
statement:
lemma cexp_eq_cexp_add_cexp (r : α → Prop) :
    f.cexp u q = f.cexp u (λ x ↦ q x ∧ r x) * f.cond r q +
      f.cexp u (λ x ↦ q x ∧ ¬r x) * (1 - f.cond r q)

name: Prob.cexp_eq_cexp_cexp
statement:
lemma cexp_eq_cexp_cexp (g : α → β) (h : ∀ x y, f.prob x ≠ 0 → g x = g y → (q x ↔ q y)) :
    f.cexp u q = (g <$> f).cexp (fun k ↦ f.cexp u (fun y ↦ g y = k))
      (fun k ↦ ∃ x, g x = k ∧ q x)

name: Prob.cexp_eq_exp
statement: lemma cexp_eq_exp (q1 : f.pr q = 1) : f.cexp u q = f.exp u

name: Prob.cexp_eq_zero
statement: lemma cexp_eq_zero (h : ∀ x, f.prob x ≠ 0 → q x → u x = 0) : f.cexp u q = 0

name: Prob.cexp_if
statement:
lemma cexp_if :
    f.cexp (λ x ↦ if p x then u x else 0) q = f.cexp u (λ x ↦ p x ∧ q x) * f.cond p q

name: Prob.cexp_le_of_forall
statement:
lemma cexp_le_of_forall {b : ℝ} (h : ∀ x, f.prob x ≠ 0 → q x → u x ≤ b) (b0 : 0 ≤ b) :
    f.cexp u q ≤ b

name: Prob.cexp_mono
statement:
lemma cexp_mono {u v : α → ℝ} (uv : ∀ x, f.prob x ≠ 0 → q x → u x ≤ v x) :
    f.cexp u q ≤ f.cexp v q

name: Prob.cexp_nonneg
statement: lemma cexp_nonneg (h : ∀ x, f.prob x ≠ 0 → q x → 0 ≤ u x) : 0 ≤ f.cexp u q

name: Prob.cexp_on_zero
statement: lemma cexp_on_zero (q0 : f.pr q = 0) : f.cexp u q = 0

name: Prob.cexp_pure
statement: lemma cexp_pure {x : α} : (pure x : Prob α).cexp u q = if q x then u x else 0

name: Prob.cexp_sum
statement:
lemma cexp_sum {s : Finset β} {u : β → α → ℝ} :
    f.cexp (λ y ↦ s.sum (λ x ↦ u x y)) q = s.sum (λ x ↦ f.cexp (u x) q)

name: Prob.cexp_zero
statement: lemma cexp_zero : f.cexp (λ _ ↦ 0) q = 0

name: Prob.cond_bind_le_first
statement:
lemma cond_bind_le_first {f : Prob α} {g : α → Prob β} (p q : β → Prop) (i j : α → Prop)
    (pi : ∀ x y, f.prob x ≠ 0 → (g x).prob y ≠ 0 → j x → p y → q y → i x)
    (jq : ∀ x y, f.prob x ≠ 0 → (g x).prob y ≠ 0 → j x → q y) :
    (f >>= λ x ↦ Prod.mk x <$> g x).cond (λ y ↦ p y.snd) (λ y ↦ q y.snd ∧ j y.fst) ≤
      f.cond i j

name: Prob.cond_bind_le_of_cut
statement:
lemma cond_bind_le_of_cut {f : Prob α} {g : α → Prob β} {p q : β → Prop} (i : α → Prop) :
    (f >>= g).cond p q ≤
      max ((f >>= λ x ↦ Prod.mk x <$> g x).cond (λ y ↦ p y.2) (λ y ↦ q y.2 ∧ i y.1))
          ((f >>= λ x ↦ Prod.mk x <$> g x).cond (λ y ↦ p y.2) (λ y ↦ q y.2 ∧ ¬i y.1))

name: Prob.cond_bind_le_of_forall_le
statement:
lemma cond_bind_le_of_forall_le {f : Prob α} {g : α → Prob β} {p q : β → Prop} {b : ℝ}
    (b0 : 0 ≤ b) (le : ∀ x, f.prob x ≠ 0 → (g x).cond p q ≤ b) : (f >>= g).cond p q ≤ b

Prob.cond_congr
statement:
lemma cond_congr {p q r : α → Prop} (pq : ∀ x, f.prob x ≠ 0 → r x → (p x ↔ q x)) :

name: Prob.cond_eq_cexp
statement: lemma cond_eq_cexp : f.cond p q = f.cexp (λ x ↦ if p x then 1 else 0) q

name: Prob.cond_eq_pr
statement: lemma cond_eq_pr (q1 : f.pr q = 1) : f.cond p q = f.pr p

name: Prob.cond_eq_zero

name: Prob.cond_le_one

name: Prob.cond_mem_Icc
statement: lemma cond_mem_Icc : f.cond p q ∈ Icc 0 1

name: Prob.cond_mono
statement: lemma cond_mono (pq : ∀ x, f.prob x ≠ 0 → r x → p x → q x) : f.cond p r ≤ f.cond q r

name: Prob.cond_neg
statement: lemma cond_neg (q0 : f.pr q ≠ 0) : f.cond (λ x ↦ ¬p x) q = 1 - f.cond p q

name: Prob.cond_nonneg
statement: lemma cond_nonneg : 0 ≤ f.cond p q

name: Prob.cond_on_zero

name: Prob.cond_pure
statement: lemma cond_pure {x : α} : (pure x : Prob α).cond p q = if p x ∧ q x then 1 else 0

name: Prob.exp_eq_cexp_add_cexp
statement:
lemma exp_eq_cexp_add_cexp (q : α → Prop) :
    f.exp u = f.cexp u q * f.pr q + f.cexp u (λ x ↦ ¬q x) * (1 - f.pr q)

name: Prob.exp_eq_exp_cexp
statement:
lemma exp_eq_exp_cexp (g : α → β) :
    f.exp u = (g <$> f).exp (fun k ↦ f.cexp u (fun y ↦ g y = k))

statement:
lemma pr_eq_cond_add_cond (q : α → Prop) :

statement: lemma count_le (f : Prob Bool) {n k : ℕ} : n < k → (count f n).prob k = 0

name: count_le'
statement: lemma count_le' (f : Prob Bool) {n k : ℕ} : (count f n).prob k ≠ 0 → k ≤ n

name: count_not
statement: lemma count_not (f : Prob Bool) (n : ℕ) : (count (not <$> f) n) = (λ x ↦ n - x) <$> count f n

name: count_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma count_zero (f : m Bool) : count f 0 = pure 0

name: mean_count
statement: lemma mean_count (f : Prob Bool) (n : ℕ) : (count f n).exp (λ x ↦ ↑x) = n * f.prob true

name: mean_estimate
statement: lemma mean_estimate (f : Prob Bool) {n : ℕ} (n0 : n ≠ 0) : (estimate f n).mean = f.prob true

name: PMF.bind_apply'
statement:
lemma PMF.bind_apply' (p : PMF α) (f : α → PMF β) (y : β) :
    (Bind.bind p f) y = ∑' x : α, p x * f x y

name: PMF.integrable_of_support_finite
statement:
lemma PMF.integrable_of_support_finite (f : PMF α) (u : α → ℝ) (hf : f.support.Finite)
    [MeasurableSpace α] [MeasurableSingletonClass α] :
    MeasureTheory.Integrable u f.toMeasure

name: PMF.prob_toProb
statement:
@[simp] lemma PMF.prob_toProb (f : PMF α) (h : f.support.Finite) (x : α) :
    (f.toProb h).prob x = ENNReal.toReal (f x)

name: PMF.pure_apply'
statement: lemma PMF.pure_apply' (x y : α) : (Pure.pure x : PMF α) y = if y = x then 1 else 0

name: PMF.toPmf_toProb
statement: theorem PMF.toPmf_toProb (f : PMF α) (hf : f.support.Finite) : (f.toProb hf).toPmf = f

name: Prob.bind_toPmf
statement:
lemma Prob.bind_toPmf (f : Prob α) (g : α → Prob β) :
    (f >>= g).toPmf = f.toPmf >>= (fun x ↦ (g x).toPmf)

name: Prob.integrable_toPmf
statement:
lemma Prob.integrable_toPmf (f : Prob α) (u : α → ℝ) [MeasurableSpace α]
    [MeasurableSingletonClass α] : MeasureTheory.Integrable u f.toPmf.toMeasure

name: Prob.integral_toPmf_eq_exp
statement:
lemma Prob.integral_toPmf_eq_exp (f : Prob α) (u : α → ℝ) [MeasurableSpace α]
    [MeasurableSingletonClass α] : ∫ x, u x ∂(f.toPmf.toMeasure) = f.exp u

name: Prob.pure_toPmf
statement: lemma Prob.pure_toPmf (x : α) : (pure x : Prob α).toPmf = pure x

name: Prob.toPmf_coe
statement: @[simp] lemma Prob.toPmf_coe (f : Prob α) (x : α) : f.toPmf x = ENNReal.ofReal (f.prob x)

name: Prob.toPmf_support_finite
statement: lemma Prob.toPmf_support_finite (f : Prob α) : f.toPmf.support.Finite

name: Prob.toProb_toPmf
statement: theorem Prob.toProb_toPmf (f : Prob α) : f.toPmf.toProb f.toPmf_support_finite = f

name: Prob.tsum_toPmf_eq_exp
statement:
lemma Prob.tsum_toPmf_eq_exp (f : Prob α) (u : α → ℝ) :
    ∑' x, (f.toPmf x).toReal * u x = f.exp u
